slides.headline: 6 SCARY CONVERSATIONS YOU CAN REHEARSE WITH AI TONIGHT
1) REHEARSE YOUR JOB INTERVIEW
slides.body: Interview coaches charge $200 an hour. He used AI instead. It caught him rambling. He got the job. 'You're interviewing me for [role]. One question at a time. Grade my answer before the next'

slides.headline: 2) TEST YOUR SALES PITCH ON THE HARDEST BUYER
slides.body: A sales coach charges $250 an hour for mock calls. AI does it free, unlimited rounds. 'You're a CFO who hates spending. I'm pitching [product]. Push back on everything'

slides.headline: 3) NEGOTIATE YOUR SALARY BEFORE THE MEETING
slides.body: Negotiation coaches charge $150 an hour. AI plays your boss and pokes every hole in your ask. 'I make [current salary] and want [target]. You're my manager. Say no. Make me convince you'

slides.headline: 4) FIRE SOMEONE WITHOUT DESTROYING THEM
slides.body: An employment lawyer charges $350 an hour to script a firing. AI rehearses it with you free. 'I need to let someone go for [reason]. Play the employee. React realistically'

slides.headline: 5) PITCH INVESTORS BEFORE THE REAL ROOM
slides.body: One bad question tanks a $500K deal. AI plays a skeptical investor and grinds every weakness first. 'I'm raising money for [company]. You're an investor who's heard a thousand pitches. Grill me'

slides.headline: 6) PRACTICE THE CONVERSATION YOU'RE AVOIDING
slides.body: Therapists charge $175 a session to rehearse hard talks. AI plays whoever you're afraid to face, unlimited rounds. 'Play my [person]. I need to tell them [thing]. React how they really would'

slides.headline: SAVE THIS FOR WHEN THE MOMENT COMES
slides.body: You'll want these prompts when the moment comes. Save this post. We share daily AI news and real skills at @yaffeai

caption:
